data.body: **[P1] Do not manufacture an interrupt after containing a plugin failure.** Merely throwing an `InterruptedException` does not prove the thread was interrupted—the added test sneaky-throws a newly constructed exception with a clear status. This block then interrupts the same executor thread that immediately runs the user handler, so subsequent blocking calls can fail and disrupt the execution despite the isolation contract; it also affects remaining plugins. Remove this re-interruption (or isolate plugin execution from the handler thread) and add an integration test asserting a throwing start hook leaves the handler thread un-interrupted.
